body.objective: Classify structured positive pseudo-Hermitian metrics and genuine C-operator candidates on the compact Weyl-Maxwell Einstein-image and additional physical blocks.
body.stop_condition: Import the exact compact physical generators, real involution, positive-frequency Hermitian form, branch maps and the P2-A contract. Compute the invariant commutant algebra before solving H^dagger eta=eta H. Classify every rational/polynomial symmetry-compatible eta, strict positivity region, singular parameter wall and representative ambiguity. Where possible construct C with C^2=1 and the declared P/T compatibility; otherwise certify the first exact obstruction. Prove basis invariance and reject an unconstrained eigenbasis metric by mutation. Export exact certificates, verifier, tests, report, receipt and atlas fragment.
body.forbid: no branch sign called quantum norm; no arbitrary positive matrix; no C operator inferred from eta alone; no residual or exceptional mode silently omitted; no particles, interacting positivity, scattering or unitarity
body.resource_hint: Exact finite blocks, but the invariant-commutant and smooth-family restrictions make the problem nontrivial.
